about.bio: Welcome to my portfolio. This space showcases functional applications designed to solve practical everyday problems, evaluate different architectural patterns, and prototype technical integrations. Rather than final commercial products, these projects serve as robust proofs-of-concept spanning from independent client-side solutions to full-stack distributed systems, acting as an advanced engineering sandbox to test failure modes and explore architectural limits. Every project displayed here is developed utilizing an AI-DLC methodology or modern AI-assisted engineering frameworks, where system design, validation, and architectural integrity remain fully directed by human engineering judgment.
